title: Odyssey ‘Endless Cruise’ Ship Stranded in Cambodia May Be Headed for Auction Block
summary_full: Efforts to pull together more funding for the ship, stuck in Cambodia, appear to have faltered, leaving its passengers unsure about what to do next.
